question: top Avocado Oil brands companies Australia
markdown:
Top avocado oil brands available or relevant in the Australian market include local estates like
Cherry Creek Estate
, international favorites like Chosen Foods, and neighboring producers like
⁠Grove Avocado Oil
. Local supermarket oils have recently faced scrutiny regarding purity and dilution claims.
Popular Brands and Market Context
Cherry Creek Estate:
Produces 100% pure Australian avocado oil sourced directly from local domestic fruit.
Chosen Foods:
Widely recognized internationally and imported into Australia via specialty grocers or online, known for high purity standards in global tests.
Grove Avocado Oil:
A premier neighboring New Zealand brand popular across Australasia for cold-pressed extra virgin options.
Supermarket Brands:
Major retailers like Coles and Woolworths stock various local and imported lines, though recent industry disputes have highlighted fluctuating quality and testing investigations.
Industry Standards & Buying Tips
Purity Checks:

⁠CHOICE

Look for Cold-Pressed:
Opt for cold-pressed or extra virgin labels to ensure minimal processing and higher nutrient retention.
